headline: ChatGPT and Codex desktop apps expand to Linux infrastructure
body: OpenAI has released Linux support for ChatGPT and Codex desktop applications, expanding platform availability across operating systems. For healthcare organizations, this matters because many clinical environments and research institutions standardize on Linux infrastructure for security, compliance, and cost reasons. Healthcare IT teams can now integrate these AI tools directly into Linux-based EHR systems, clinical decision support workflows, and medical coding automation without requiring Windows or macOS workarounds. The move reduces deployment friction for healthcare systems evaluating GPT-based solutions for clinical documentation, coding accuracy, and operational efficiency.
